name: optimize
description: Small optimization problems solved exactly with scipy: maximize/minimize a linear objective under resource constraints (budget 5000, item A 200 each max 10, item B 450 each max 6), plus minimize/maximize a function of one variable. The optimum and binding constraints come from the solver, not a guess.
route: optimize the budget, maximize with constraints, minimize x^2 at, best mix of A and B, linear program
